name: app-investment-app-in-hand-orange-phone-closeup
title: Tilted close-up of an investing app in an orange phone held in a hand
whatItIs: A rounded light-grey frame with a huge angled close-up of an orange phone in a hand. The screen shows a greeting, metrics, small yield bars and the start of a chart, in italicised perspective.
whatItMeans: Modern and tactile; the dramatic angle makes the interface feel alive and desirable.
techniques: Use an extreme angled close-up to make text swoop across the frame.
Pick a phone colour that complements the UI accent.
Crop the device to fill the frame.
Frame the shot in a rounded card with a small studio tag.

vocabulary.definition: A close, angled view where the screen recedes.
A phone colour chosen to complement the UI.
A card-shaped container around a project image.
A small label with a designer's name.
